author: A. S. Kyle
title: South Dakota volleyball releases 2026 schedule with home and away matches
text:
South Dakota volleyball announced its full 2026 schedule on May 27, featuring 10 regular season matches and one exhibition at the Sanford Coyote Sports Center in Vermillion. The Coyotes will also play several games on the road, including tournaments and nonconference matchups.
The team’s preseason begins with an exhibition against Creighton, the reigning Big East champions, at DJ Sokol in Omaha, Nebraska, on August 16. South Dakota will then host Augustana for a final exhibition match at the Sanford Coyote Sports Center on August 22 before starting its nonconference slate in Des Moines at the Drake Tournament from August 28 to 30. During this tournament, South Dakota faces Drake on August 28, Milwaukee—head coach Leanne Williamson’s alma mater—on August 29, and DePaul on August 30.
The Coyotes will host Utah Valley, Northern Iowa, and Air Force from September 3 to September 5 for the South Dakota Classic. Matches are scheduled against Utah Valley Thursday night, Northern Iowa Friday night, and Air Force Saturday afternoon. The following weekend includes a tournament co-hosted by Colorado State and Wyoming; South Dakota plays Colorado State in Fort Collins on September 10, Wyoming in Laramie on September 11, and UC Santa Barbara back in Fort Collins on September 12.
Nonconference play concludes with the South Dakota Lottery Classic at Sioux Falls’ Sanford Pentagon against Minnesota (September 18) and Washington (September 19), both Big Ten opponents. The remainder of the schedule features Summit League opponents such as South Dakota State (home: Sept. 25; away: Oct.23), St. Thomas (away: Oct.1; home: Oct.31), Omaha (away: Oct.3; home: Oct.29), Oral Roberts (home: Oct.8; away: Nov.7), Kansas City (home: Oct.10; away: Nov.5), North Dakota (away: Oct.15; home: Nov.14), and North Dakota State (away: Oct.17; home: Nov.12). The Summit League Tournament is set to take place in Brookings with dates to be announced.
Match times are yet to be determined for all games listed in the schedule.
